coverage_decision: Semantically batched for extraction and hierarchical SEA synthesis. One publication identity is preserved across all batches.

visual_reconciliation.finding: Cohort flow is recoverable, but its matched-arm denominator of 11,077 conflicts with Results/Table/Supplement values of 11,007.
The primary survival curves separate modestly over 360 days; the displayed risk set falls from 11,007 per group at day 1 to 4,805 vs 4,575 at day 360.
Prematching imbalances are substantially reduced after matching; all displayed postmatch SMDs are below 0.1.
Propensity-score distributions overlap closely after matching.
Hospitalization-free curves favor empagliflozin modestly; day-360 risk set 4,823 vs 4,595.
Mortality curves nearly overlap; day-360 risk set 6,799 vs 6,838.
HFrEF matched characteristics satisfy balance criterion; composite HR 0.92 with modest curve separation.
HFpEF matched characteristics satisfy balance criterion; composite HR 0.91 with modest curve separation.

omissions_and_reasons: Bibliography entries were not atomized because they are provenance infrastructure; they are exported separately to Markdown.
Supplement 2 (Data Sharing Statement) was referenced by the article but was not supplied and therefore was not analyzed.
No external web sources were used for scientific verification because the user requested processing of the supplied paper and supplement, not external verification.

source_consistency_findings.finding: Matched cohort denominator conflict: the abstract and Figure 1 report 11,077 patients per group, while the Results text, main baseline table, Supplement overall analyses, and reported event percentages are consistent with 11,007 per group.
source_consistency_findings.handling: Atoms using matched-arm denominators use 11,007 and are tagged as Results/Table/Supplement denominators. The conflicting 11,077 value is preserved in this validation report and SEA artifact rather than silently repaired.

source_consistency_findings.finding: The Limitations paragraph cites reference 20 for immortal-time bias, but reference 19 is Yadav and Lewis on immortal-time bias; reference 20 is Juurlink et al. on hyperkalemia after RALES.
source_consistency_findings.handling: The reference list is exported in the source's original numbering. The mismatch is flagged in validation and SEA.
